statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-116319 (PostgreSQL plperl reentrant return_next() use-after-free executes arbitrary code) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 16.16. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116319/, lists 16.16 as the fixed release for major version 16, the 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/, list this CVE, and the CVE record, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116319, lists 16 as affected before 16.16. The fix on the REL_16_STABLE branch is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/a78974d347603f635b4d202c06b6e008fd2e8b65, which changes src/pl/plperl/plperl.c, carries the trailer "Security: CVE-2026-116319" and is contained in the REL_16_16 tag. Alpine's postgresql16 16.16-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch upgrades to the upstream 16.16 release and lists CVE-2026-116319 under 16.16-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD. None of the Alpine patches applied in that APKBUILD change those files. The DHI postgresql16 16.16-r0 package for Alpine 3.23 is built from that APKBUILD and the upstream PostgreSQL 16.16 source tarball, and its postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 16.16 on both x86_64 and aarch64. PL/Perl is built (configure --with-perl) and shipped as plperl.so in the postgresql16-plperl subpackage of every published build for Alpine 3.23 (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0, 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0), on both architectures. Every earlier published build for Alpine 3.23 (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0) is an upstream release before 16.16, and its postgres server binary reports that older 16.x release on both architectures, so it is affected; 16.16-r0 and later carry the fix.

CVE-2026-116319 (PostgreSQL plperl reentrant return_next() use-after-free executes arbitrary code) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 17.12 for major version 17. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116319/, lists 17.12 as the fixed release for 17, the 17.12 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.12/, list this CVE, and the CVE record, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116319, lists 17 as affected before 17.12. The fix on the REL_17_STABLE branch is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/eab8001348eed01401e06b4aa4876817dff005ba, which carries the trailer "Security: CVE-2026-116319", is contained in the REL_17_12 tag and not in REL_17_11, and changes src/pl/plperl/plperl.c so that return_next() creates and deletes a temporary memory context for each call instead of reusing one that a re-entrant call could reset; its other changes are regression tests. Alpine's postgresql17 17.12-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch upgrades to the upstream 17.12 release and lists CVE-2026-116319 under 17.12-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/ce22298320177ae25085d86fbf3b4fc1150c16a2/main/postgresql17/APKBUILD. None of the Alpine patches applied in that APKBUILD change the files the fix touches. The DHI postgresql17 17.12-r0 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from that APKBUILD and the upstream PostgreSQL 17.12 source tarball. The DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository (main and security, x86_64 and aarch64) publishes packages built from source postgresql17 at 17.7-r0, 17.8-r0, 17.9-r0, 17.10-r0, 17.11-r0 and 17.12-r0. The vulnerable code is in PL/Perl, usr/lib/postgresql17/plperl.so, which the postgresql17-plperl subpackage ships in every published build on both architectures. In the 17.12-r0 build the postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on both x86_64 and aarch64, and in each earlier build (17.7-r0, 17.8-r0, 17.9-r0, 17.10-r0 and 17.11-r0) it reports that older 17.x release on both architectures. The earlier builds are upstream releases before 17.12, so they are affected; 17.12-r0 and later carry the fix.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-116319, a use after free in PL/Perl through reentrant return_next() calls, in 17.12; earlier 17 releases are affected (https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116319/, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116319). The server binary in this owner's 17.12-0 build and in its rebuild of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on amd64 and arm64, so both carry the fix. The 17.11-1 build and the current rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 report PostgreSQL 17.11, and the earlier rebuilds of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1, no longer in the repository, package PostgreSQL 17.10 and 17.11. All of these are affected and sort below 17.12-0. PL/Perl ships in this owner's postgresql-plperl-17 package built from Debian's source; the 17.11-1 and 17.12-0 packages do not include it.
